objects.name: Analytic 2229
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol file-transfer service placing a file on a field device from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, where the transferred filename pattern matches firmware images or executable payloads inconsistent with the device's normal data exchange profile. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: otids:ProtocolDecoder
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Decoded DNP3/IEC 61850 file-transfer transaction: source/destination and file/object identifier where exposed; correlate with approved engineering source and change window

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of network shares/hosts authorized to write executable or script files to ICS Windows assets.
IP allowlist of workstations authorized to perform file transfers to field devices.
Filename/extension patterns inconsistent with the device's normal configuration exchange profile.
